summary: reserveBudget race lets two concurrent requests bypass cap by 1

resolution.test_function: upserts the row, then atomically check-increments under the limit
resolution.note: False positive at capture: reserveBudget was already a single-statement atomic UPDATE with the cap check in its own WHERE + RETURNING (spend.ts:102-112) since 27fc525, which predates the ticket. Postgres row locks serialize concurrent increments; bypass-by-1 cannot occur.
